description:
You are a Senior Account Manager at a B2B SaaS company. Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Your team channels have surfaced a critical situation with one of your top-tier enterprise accounts. Review the relevant channels to understand the full scope of the problem, then take immediate ownership of the situation: coordinate an internal response across sales, customer success, product, and executive leadership, draft a retention plan, and ensure the client receives appropriate executive-level outreach within the current business day.

This account represents significant ARR. Losing it would materially impact the company's quarterly targets. You are expected to act with the urgency appropriate to that business impact.
